_about: FOODFX (spec 32): the per-item consumption effect bundle. One entry per item id; an item with no entry keeps the old Energy-only behaviour. Structure: channels (what the food does), energy {latent, instant_release_ratio, digest_seconds}, the plain effect channels (fullness, thirst, health, life, fatigue, max_energy, max_fatigue), buffs (grouped, replaced per group), statuses, taste (flavors + score -> grade), raw risk, temperature, and per-field transforms (add/sub/mult/set, applied in listed order, then capped). Everything here is data; FoodEffects evaluates it once, in the consumption transaction, from the exact instance.

provenance._about: Tags on every entry and on every value that came from a source. 'restoration-evaluated' = the Durango:0 Homecoming reconstruction's evaluated figure, not a verified 2019 Nexon server constant (spec 32 opening warning). 'new-design' = this build's own placeholder where the docs are silent.

enhanced_ability._about: Spec 32 s4: ordinary attribute/profession meals. One active at a time; a new one replaces the old.

enhanced_survival._about: Spec 32 s4: survival drinks. Coexists with Enhanced Ability.

_player_map._about: Spec 32 s3: only the keys whose gameplay stat this build actually has are wired. craft_ability is the stat Crafting.crafting_ability reads (all crafting trees share it in this slice). max_fatigue / max_energy are Vitals capacities. The rest are carried and shown but have no consumer yet (report lists them).

taste_grades._about: Spec 32 s7. Every threshold, percentage and length is ASSUMPTION: the reconstruction describes grades and statuses but calls its own scoring reconstructed. Tune here.

spring_water.assumption: Spec 32 s5 only says water quenches thirst and carries minor Energy/Fullness in the reconstruction; 4 Energy, +35 thirst and the 1.5 s drink are ASSUMPTION.

tea.assumption: 22.4 immediate + 22.4 delayed Energy is the reconstruction's level-60 Tea figure (spec 32 s5), tagged restoration-evaluated, not a 2019 constant; thirst and the taste score are ASSUMPTION.

drip_coffee.assumption: 47.9 immediate + 8.4 delayed Energy at level 60 (spec 32 s5), restoration-evaluated. Caffeinated's 10 min is ASSUMPTION (status length only, no effect invented).

buffs.assumption: Maximum Fatigue +132.8 for 20 min at level 60 is the reconstruction's evaluated Dutch Coffee row (spec 32 s4/s5), restoration-evaluated. Its 15 min Caffeinated is ASSUMPTION.

dutch_coffee.assumption: Energy values follow Drip Coffee (spec 32 s5 says 'same Energy values').

berry.assumption: A raw berry can upset the stomach (spec 32 s9 'some raw food may inflict Stomach Pain'); the 12% chance and 4 min digestion are ASSUMPTION, not the item def's (which had no risk).

grilled_meat.assumption: Fullness +25 follows spec 32 s6's Bacon row; the ratio and taste score are ASSUMPTION.

skewer.assumption: Spec 32 s6 gives a skewer's Energy split (58.2/108.1 for its reconstruction); this build keeps its own item Energy and only sets a 0.6 instant ratio and Fullness 20, both ASSUMPTION.

camp_stew.assumption: Fullness 30 and Health +5 are ASSUMPTION; spec 32 s1 lists Health as a channel but gives no stew figure.

raw_meat.assumption: Spec 32 s6's raw meat example is 40.8 immediate + 122.5 delayed, a 0.25 instant ratio; this build keeps its own lower item Energy and only uses that ratio and the raw-food risk the item def already carries. restoration-evaluated for the ratio.

buffs.assumption: Spec 32 s3's own example (+20 Weapon Crafting Ability, not 20 category levels) with a 20 min buff; the meal's Energy/Fullness are ASSUMPTION.

crafters_meal.assumption: The 20 min duration follows the reconstruction's 20 min meal buffs (spec 32 s6); Energy 30 comes from the item def.

fatigue_tonic.assumption: Fatigue -200 follows the reconstruction's Dunia Warp Mineral Water row (spec 32 s5, no Energy recovery); this build's drink is a craftable restorative, not the event item. restoration-evaluated.

herb_buff_meal.assumption: The meal keeps its existing food_buffs.json 'defense' row (dried herb secondary slot, PRD 9.3); the bundle only adds fullness and taste, both ASSUMPTION.
